# Area: ruleaudit

Started by the build lead from this brief (2026-11-13). It is the definition of done.

Rule audit (Opus, Josh): FLOW-34 was marked built but its tests never checked that the Start screen plays music. Audit every 'built' row in docs/build/rule-status.csv (about 150): split the GDD SH1.0 rule text (docs/gdd/GDD-SH1.0.md) into its clauses, read the bodies of the evidence tests (Source/UmbrellaElla/Private/Tests/**, tests/*.py) and decide for each clause whether a test proves it. Any clause no test proves: set the row to 'partial' and name the missing clause(s) in its note ('unproven: ...'). Order: P0 rows and everything a player sees or hears in the first minute first (start screen, title/menu music, HUD, controls, pause, defeat, credits), then the rest. No code changes; read-only except rule-status.csv and docs/build/areas/ruleaudit-status.md. Commit every ~15 rows (PRECHECK_FAST=1 bash tools/build/lane_precheck.sh ruleaudit --bg, then commit) so the gate lands the downgrades fast, and keep a running list in your status: row, missing clause, owning area (mill=enemies2, arena=levelchunks, story/settings/progression/UI=settings2, keeper/agent=agentplay, audio/flow=titlemusic). Report after the first 30 minutes: rows audited, rows downgraded.
